```{r Package Load}
# Install first time with commented line below or for updates
remotes::install_github("HenryTraynor/RoostEpiPkg")
library(RoostEpiPkg)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(progress)

set.seed(123)
```

```{r Helper Function}
# Approximate Clark-Evans R for points in a unit-square landscape
calculate_clark_evans_R <- function(x, y) {
  coords <- cbind(x, y)
  n <- nrow(coords)

  distances <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  diag(distances) <- Inf

  mean_nn <- mean(apply(distances, 1, min))
  expected_nn <- 0.5 / sqrt(n)

  mean_nn / expected_nn
}



```

```{r Model Parameters}
# Epidemic parameters
epi_params <- create_epidemic_params(
  beta = 0.5,
  gamma = 0.03,
  model = "SIR"
)

# create spatial parameters and grid
spatial_params <- create_spatial_params(
  nx = 50,
  ny = 50
)

# Number of roosts
num_roosts <- 100

# Spatial clustering parameters
cluster_range <- c(1,round(num_roosts/4))
cluster_res <- 2
cluster_seq <- seq(
  cluster_range[1],
  cluster_range[2],
  by=cluster_res
)
sd_range <- c(0.03, 0.2)
sd_seq <- seq(sd_range[1], sd_range[2], length=length(cluster_seq))

# df of paired spatial params
spatial_distribution <- data.frame(
  num_clusters = cluster_seq,
  sd = sd_seq
)

# modern building proportion sequence
prop_modern_values <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)


# sim length params
n_replicates <- 1
n_days <- 100

```

```{r Simulation}
# Total number of simulations
total_simulations <- length(prop_modern_values) *
                     nrow(spatial_distribution) *
                     n_replicates

results <- list()
counter <- 1

pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "  Simulating [:bar] :percent | Elapsed: :elapsed | ETA: :eta",
  total = total_simulations,
  clear = FALSE,
  width = 60
)

for (p in prop_modern_values) {
  for (nc in num_clusters_values) {
    for (rep in seq_len(n_replicates)) {

      # Generate roosts
      roost_info <- create_roosts(
        num_roosts = num_roosts,
        num_clusters = nc,
        prop_modern = p
      )

      # Measure realized spatial structure
      realized_R <- calculate_clark_evans_R(
        roost_info$x,
        roost_info$y
      )

      # Initialize populations
      roost_info <- initialize_roost_populations(
        roost_info,
        initial_occupancy = 0.25,
        initial_infected = 0.25
      )

      # Configure movement
      movement_params <- setup_movement(
        roost_info = roost_info,
        spatial_params = spatial_params
      )

      # Run SIR simulation
      sim <- run_simulation(
        roost_info = roost_info,
        spatial_params = spatial_params,
        movement_params = movement_params,
        epidemic_params = epi_params,
        n_days = n_days
      )

      # Peak prevalence across days
      daily_prevalence <- vapply(
        sim,
        function(day) {
          roosts <- day$roosts
          total_N <- sum(roosts$N)

          if (total_N <= 0) {
            return(NA_real_)
          }

          sum(roosts$I) / total_N
        },
        numeric(1)
      )

      peak_prevalence <- if (
        all(is.na(daily_prevalence))
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        max(daily_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE)
      }

      results[[counter]] <- data.frame(
        prop_modern = p,
        num_clusters = nc,
        Clark_Evans_R = realized_R,
        replicate = rep,
        peak_prevalence = peak_prevalence
      )

      counter <- counter + 1
      
      # Update progress bar
      pb$message(sprintf("prop_modern = %.2f, clusters = %d", p, nc))
      pb$tick()
      
    }
  }
}

results_df <- bind_rows(results)
```

```{r Plotting}
heatmap_data <- results_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(peak_prevalence)) %>%
  mutate(
    R_bin = cut(
      Clark_Evans_R,
      breaks = seq(
        floor(min(Clark_Evans_R, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10,
        ceiling(max(Clark_Evans_R, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1,
        by = 0.1
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(prop_modern, R_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_R = mean(Clark_Evans_R),
    mean_peak_prevalence = mean(peak_prevalence),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  heatmap_data,
  aes(
    x = prop_modern,
    y = mean_R,
    fill = mean_peak_prevalence
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Mean peak\nprevalence",
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Proportion of modern roosts",
    breaks = prop_modern_values
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Clark-Evans R",
    title = "SIR epidemic intensity across urbanization and spatial structure"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
